representative_seed_policy: lowest validation_error among task_success=true seeds; if none succeed, lowest-validation-error checkpoint is an explicit failed-task fallback

empirical_slow_subspace.definition: top eigenspace of mean_h J_16(h)^T J_16(h) over clean atlas anchors
empirical_slow_subspace.rank_rule: retain every eigen-direction whose sqrt eigenvalue is at least 0.9; expanding directions are retained rather than misclassified as contracting normals

finite_kicks.same_memory_reference: corresponding clean anchor under the same blank horizon

state_geometry.pairwise_distortion: log(distance_H / distance_0), with the global median removed before dispersion
